_comment: Per-role cover letter content for Capgemini, keyed by requisition id. Rendered by app/letters.py through career-ops' generate-cover-letter.mjs, which fact-checks the result against cv.md - so every claim here is one the CV already evidences. Written against each posting's own text, fetched with capgemini_board.fetch_description. A letter belongs to ONE requisition: its reference number is printed in the body, so these are never reused across postings.
_voice: Sell the fit. Name strengths and evidence only. Never state that a required skill is missing, never measure the years asked against the years held, and never concede the profile may not suit - a gap is handled by not raising it, not by confessing it. The fact check already prevents claiming what the CV cannot support, so honesty is enforced by what is asserted, not by volunteering what is absent.

Chez UrbanSeller, j'avais livré une plateforme de gestion de commandes avec un backend C#/.NET, des API REST documentées sous Swagger et un frontend Angular.
